title: BrandMetadata
description: The metadata required to build the brand registration form.

brandMetadataId.description: The unique identifier for the brand metadata.

marketCode.description: The market code for the brand metadata type.

majorVersion.description: The major version of the brand metadata type.

minorVersion.description: The minor version of the brand metadata type.

createTime.description: The date and time when the brand metadata was created.

data.description: The list of categories included in the brand metadata. Each of them includes a list of attributes.

BrandMetadataCategory.description: A category of data that contains a set of attributes and validation rules.

title.description: Title is useful to display the category in the UI.

attributes.description: The list of attributes included in the category.

BrandMetadataCategoryAttribute.description: An attribute of a category that contains a set of validation rules.

description.description: Attribute description. It should be used as a description, hoover or helping text in a UI.

title.description: Title of the attribute that can be used in the UI to request the attribute field.

required.description: Indicates whether the attribute is required or not.

name.description: Name of the field. Serves as a key (reference) to a field

maxLength.description: Max length of the field value

minLength.description: Min length of the field value

minItems.description: The minimum number of items in the array that must be selected. Used in array types.

items.description: Some attributes can be an array of items. This field is used to define the values the customer can select.

type.description: The type of the attribute. Along with the type, api can provide a set of values under enum property

enum.description: The list of possible values for the attribute.

minItems.description: The minimum number of items in the array that must be selected. Used in array types.

multiline.description: Indicates whether the attribute is a multiline text field or not.

x-enumDescriptions.US_SHORT_CODE_REGISTRY: US Short Code Registry, for US Short Code Campaigns.
